issue_context.title: Deprecate AlgorithmProvider flag and algorithmProvider scheduler pkg
issue_context.body:
#### What would you like to be added:

1. Remove [AlgorithmProvider](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8c0d06aad87047235beafd14546ff8418499b17e/cmd/kube-scheduler/app/options/deprecated.go#L50) flag. This flag was marked as deprecated since v1.17, we can remove it now.
2. Remove the [algorithmprovider](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/master/pkg/scheduler/algorithmprovider) pkg. The default set of plugins would move to be set in the component config defaulting logic.

#### Why is this needed:
1. To enable versioning the default set of scheduler plugins 
2. Cleanup: unify defaulting for scheduler configuration 


/sig scheduling
